subject: Request: demo window push + trial runway for Skyline AI integration
messages:
From: Alex Perry <alex.perry@skyline.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Skyline POC: request to extend demo window & credits

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the help this week — the team was able to get a first pass of the Redwood connector running, but we've hit a blocker on our side that's going to delay the public demo window we had scheduled for the 30th. Our infra team discovered an intermittent auth/refresh race in our SSO adapter; until that's resolved we can't complete end-to-end flows for the demo.

Because of that, we'd like to request a modest runway extension and a sandbox/top-up to cover additional evals while our engineers fix the adapter. Specifically:
- +50k sandbox tokens (or equivalent credit) for the Skyline dev team to continue isolated testing
- a 2-week extension of the hosted trial/demo window (moving the target demo date to ~Jul 14)

We're aiming to have the bug fixed by Mon Jun 28 but want to avoid rushing the demo and risking a bad first impression.

I've attached the minimal integration_log.txt showing the failing refresh sequence. Happy to jump on a quick call with your engineers to walk through it.

Best,
Alex Perry
Head of ML Engineering, Skyline AI
Attachments: integration_log.txt (text)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perry <alex.perry@skyline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyline POC: request to extend demo window & credits

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the logs. Sorry to hear about the SSO snag; that class of race condition is noisy to reproduce.

High level next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Ben (AE) and Marissa (Customer Success) to help with approvals and to coordinate the demo cadence.
- We can provision a temporary sandbox top-up while the team triages — I can provision an interim 50k tokens as a goodwill credit pending final sign-off.
- Can you confirm the minimum demo date you need (Jul 14 as suggested, or would Jul 21 be safer)? If your engineers need until Jun 28 to fix and then a week for verification, Jul 14 may be tight.

Also, please share any additional failing traces or steps to reproduce; I can have a Redwood engineer join a triage call if that helps.

I'll let Ben/Marissa confirm the formal extension and any paperwork. If helpful, propose a 30-min slot this week for a quick triage — Wed 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT both work for me.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Alex Perry <alex.perry@skyline.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@skyline.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyline POC: request to extend demo window & credits

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 09:05 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the logs.
>
Thanks, Soojin. Quick responses below and a bit more color on our timeline.

- Confirmed: our engineers expect to have the SSO race fixed by Mon Jun 28; they then want 7 business days to run integration/QA (safety and load checks) which puts us at Mon Jul 12 for a stable demo build.
- Given that, a demo target date of Jul 14 is actually tight but probably doable; Jul 21 would be safer if Redwood needs any time to revalidate on your side.
- We'd prefer the 50k tokens to be available immediately so we can continue stress testing against the patched flow.

I've attached an updated SOW-draft.pdf that shows the proposed schedule and a brief note from our infra lead. If you can provision the tokens and confirm the extension to Jul 12 (or Jul 21 if you prefer extra buffer), we'll lock the internal calendar.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Happy to take Wed 10am PT for a triage call; I'll include our infra lead.

Best,
Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Perry <alex.perry@skyline.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: sandbox credit top-up + trial extension (Skyline AI / DEAL-7891)

Alex / Maya — thanks for the clarity and timeline. Quick update from Redwood: we've approved the following as a one-time exception for this POC given the engineering dependency you described.

Approved items:
- Sandbox credit: 50,000 tokens (issued immediately; credit_adjustment.pdf attached summarizing the change)
- Trial/demo extension: moved outbound demo window to 2027-07-12 (we'll revisit if you move to Jul 21)

Operational notes:
- We've recorded the change on the HubSpot deal (DEAL-7891) and added the credit line to your sandbox account. See: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-7891
- Please review the SOW-draft.pdf and confirm any redlines. If you need a formal amendment/DocuSign, let us know and we'll route it today.

Next steps:
1) Soojin / Marissa: coordinate the triage call Wed 10am PT.
2) Alex: confirm you've received the sandbox top-up and that the SAML/refresh logs are reproducible in the provisioned environment.
3) If you want an extension to Jul 21 instead, let us know and we'll update the paperwork.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: credit_adjustment.pdf (pdf)
